title: Decomposition of predictive uncertainty in a Bayesian convolutional network for out-of-distribution detection: code and results
description: Code, saved per-run metrics and raw per-object uncertainty scores for the study of predictive uncertainty decomposition (aleatoric and epistemic components) in a mean-field Bayesian convolutional network trained on FashionMNIST. Experiments cover five types of distribution shift (MNIST, KMNIST, held-out FashionMNIST classes, rotations, Gaussian noise) under several training regimes with five fixed seeds each. Scripts in src/ rebuild every table and figure of the paper from the files in results/. Supplementary tables S1–S4 with per-run values are in docs/tables_S1-S4.md and results/tables/; src/figures_article.py produces the article figures in the journal format (panels a and b as separate files).
